liturgicalName: 3rd Sunday of Lent (Year A readings may be used)
keyVerseDR: "...make not the house of my Father a house of traffic." (Jn 2:16)

level1.title: God's House
level1.story: Jesus went to the Temple. People were selling animals and changing money there. Jesus drove them out and said, "Do not make My Father's house a market!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say God's house is for?
How do you act in church?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I love Your house. Amen.

activity.title: Things in God's house
activity.intro: Match each picture to its name.

level2.title: Cleansing the Temple
level2.story: When the Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem. In the Temple He found people selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and money changers sitting there. He made a whip of cords and drove them all out, overturning the tables. Jesus said, "Make not the house of My Father a house of traffic." When the leaders asked for a sign, Jesus said, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up," speaking of the temple of His body.
level2.keyLine: Make not the house of my Father a house of traffic.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is your body a temple of the Holy Spirit?
level2.prayer: Jesus, cleanse my heart and make it Your temple. Amen.

activity.title: Around the altar
activity.intro: Church is God's house. Match each item to where it is.
pairs: At the center of the sanctuary
Where the Blessed Sacrament is kept
